access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-07 (T-3449). Luman Reed (1785-1836), a New York wholesale grocer, painted in 1835: a black coat with a high rolled collar, a wide black stock wound high under the jaw, the white points of his shirt collar standing up at the cheeks, a white shirt front, short side whiskers. A merchant of the scene year, in New York, not Chicago.
note: One of the 1835 merchant reference set's pictures (data/people_match/reference_sets/merchant_1835.json).
